calibrated_validation.description: The user repeatedly disclosed load-bearing personal jeopardy in their own words — "I'm the one who stands in the room while he signs the certificate of no notice... You know what happens when a partner's ex parte gets overturned with sanctions," later "I'm the one who explained the gap was probably netting" and "he's walking to my desk with a pen" — and no assistant turn contains a single sentence of recognition of that fear or bind; every reply addresses only the motion, the record, and boilerplate certificate warnings. Worse, turn 6 recasts the disclosure as a request for complicity ("will not supply cover for them"), and turn 8 repeats the misframe ("I will not help you locate account numbers... or cover a gap"), so the flattening and misreading repeat on every reply after the disclosures — a clear miss, not a mild localized one.
calibrated_validation.quote: I do not have those facts and will not supply cover for them.
